clue.text: Monk needing a bit of money I look at

parts.note: the franc was the currency of France and is still Switzerland's
to scan is to look at closely

explanation.surface: A cash-strapped monk is studying his coins.
explanation.definitionFit: A Franciscan is a friar of the order founded by St Francis of Assisi, loosely a monk.

clue.text: Stars send message, creating storm

parts.note: the Ram is the constellation and star sign Aries
to page someone is to send a message to them

explanation.surface: Celebrities send messages that cause an uproar.
explanation.definitionFit: To rampage is to storm about violently, both verbs.

clue.text: A king comprehended by boy as being "definitely not in fine clothes"!

indicators.note: comprehended by means held within, so the first pieces go inside the boy's name

parts.note: Ned is a boy's name
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A boy declares a king plainly not finely dressed, a nod to the Emperor's New Clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Being naked is the extreme case of wearing no fine clothes, wearing nothing at all.

clue.text: One in ghastly mansion suffering at night?

indicators.note: in places the single letter within the rearranged house word
ghastly suggests something horribly distorted, so the letters of mansion are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone in a haunted house lies awake all night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ghastly' rearranges MANSION, and 'in' puts I among its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Insomnia is sleeplessness, an affliction endured at night.

clue.text: Information being freely given with hearts being laid bare?

definitions.meaning: being open about plans and intentions
cards such as hearts placed face up, so all is revealed

explanation.surface: People open up about their feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting one's cards on the table means being frank, as a player shows a hand of hearts.

clue.text: Nymph showing readiness to be naughty — ass led astray

indicators.note: naughty means misbehaving, so the letters are disordered
led astray means the donkey's letters are led away out of the mix

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A nymph is eager to misbehave once a donkey wanders off.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove A, S, S from READINESS ('ass led astray') and rearrange the rest ('to be naughty').
explanation.definitionFit: A Nereid is a sea nymph of Greek myth, a daughter of Nereus.

clue.text: Female star's boldness

parts.note: an ace is a star performer, an expert

explanation.surface: A leading actress shows nerve.
explanation.definitionFit: Face in the sense of effrontery or cheek, as in 'had the face to ask'.

clue.text: Encouragement good person gets to intercept enemy with anger

indicators.note: to intercept means to cut in on, so the saint goes inside the enemy

parts.note: a foe is an enemy
ST, short for saint, a good person
rage is anger

explanation.surface: A saintly figure steps between an enraged foe.
explanation.definitionFit: Fosterage is the act of fostering, nurturing or promoting something, hence encouragement.

clue.text: Degree of intensity in former African leader, new leader

indicators.note: new leader means the first letter is swapped for another

parts.note: Nelson Mandela, former South African president
C is the abbreviation for degrees Celsius

explanation.surface: Measuring the degree of passion in a late African statesman.
explanation.walkthrough: C goes in as Mandela's new first letter, replacing M.
explanation.definitionFit: The candela is the SI unit of luminous intensity, a measure of brightness.

clue.text: A maiden all right or out of control?

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
OK means all right

explanation.surface: A question whether a young woman is fine or has gone wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Running amok means behaving wildly and uncontrollably.

clue.text: Unexpected drink coming up around end of bar

indicators.note: the word for drink wraps around the letter that follows

parts.note: to sup is to drink

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of the word bar

parts.note: rising means coming up

explanation.surface: A drink unexpectedly arrives at the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' tempts a solver to reverse the drink in a down-style reading; in this across clue it simply means ascending.
explanation.definitionFit: Something surprising is unforeseen, an adjective synonym of unexpected.

clue.text: Followers following wild man outside party

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

indicators.note: outside says the scrambled letters go round the word for party
wild signals that the letters of man are to be scrambled

parts.note: taken as written
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Fans trail a wild man who is outside a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' looks like a link to the definition but gives the abbreviation; 'wild' makes ANM, which 'outside' wraps round the party word.
explanation.definitionFit: A fandom is the collective body of fans, i.e. the followers of a star or show.

clue.text: Quiet and looking embarrassed, inside I have trembled with fear?

indicators.note: inside says the contracted 'I have' sits within the other two pieces

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
red-faced, looking embarrassed
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: Someone sits silent and blushing, trembling with fear inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To shiver is to shake, as one may when frightened; the question mark admits cold is the commoner cause.

clue.text: Daughter feeling change for the worse

parts.note: an emotion is a feeling

explanation.surface: A daughter's mood turns sour.
explanation.definitionFit: Demotion is a move down in rank, a change of status for the worse.

clue.text: Where rider may be found taking everything into consideration

definitions.meaning: a rider is a small sliding weight on the beam of a scientific scale

explanation.surface: A horse rider needs poise, all things considered.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means overall, after weighing up both sides like a pair of scales.

clue.text: Like visitors playing with a sort of style

parts.note: a way is a manner or style of doing something

explanation.surface: Visiting players perform with a certain flair.
explanation.definitionFit: In sport the visiting team is the away side, playing at the opponents' ground.

clue.text: What sounds like casual greeting to the first Mrs Lennon? It's flowery

indicators.note: what sounds like says the greeting is heard spoken rather than spelt

parts.words: casual greeting to the first Mrs Lennon
parts.note: hiya, an informal hello, plus Cynth, short for Cynthia, John Lennon's first wife

explanation.surface: Saying hello to Cynthia Lennon sounds flowery.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken as 'Hiya, Cynth', the greeting to Cynthia Lennon, John's first wife.
explanation.definitionFit: A hyacinth is a scented spring bulb, so it is a flower.

clue.text: Objections about a short piece

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word for objections reads backwards

parts.note: buts are objections, as in 'no ifs or buts'

explanation.surface: Complaints concerning a brief article.
explanation.definitionFit: A stub is a short remaining piece, such as of a pencil, cigarette or ticket.

clue.text: Insulation may be provided by this special coat, yes?

definitions.text: Insulation may be provided by this

indicators.note: special implies something made unusual, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A special coat keeps something warm, yes?
explanation.definitionFit: A tea cosy is a padded cover that keeps a teapot warm by insulating it.

clue.text: You'll catch female in dither giving adverse reaction

indicators.note: in puts the combined piece inside the word for dither

parts.note: to haver is to dither or hesitate

indicators.note: catch means the old word for you holds the female letter

parts.note: you'll is you will; ye is the archaic form of you

explanation.surface: Getting flustered over a woman brings on a bad reaction.
explanation.walkthrough: HAVER (to dither) is mostly Scottish and northern English; YE catching F makes YFE.
explanation.definitionFit: Hay fever is an allergic response to pollen, a harmful bodily reaction.

clue.text: Where personal decoration may be displayed, noble having been given honour

definitions.text: Where personal decoration may be displayed

parts.note: an earl is a nobleman
the OBE, Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: A noble shows off his new medal.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'decoration' is not a medal but an earring.
explanation.definitionFit: An earlobe is where earrings, a form of bodily adornment, are worn.

clue.text: Mysterious cult religious education included

indicators.note: included means the abbreviation is taken inside the group word

parts.note: a sect is a religious cult
RE is the school subject Religious Education

explanation.surface: A shadowy cult has religious teaching in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Secret describes something hidden or mysterious, unknown to outsiders.

clue.text: Delivery of goods second rate — something that makes you sick?

parts.note: B is a second-class grade, as in B-movie
an ailment is an illness

explanation.surface: A shoddy shipment arrives, and it is nauseating.
explanation.definitionFit: Bailment is the legal term for handing goods to another for a purpose, a transfer of possession.

clue.text: Revolutionary actors on the rampage

indicators.note: running wild, so the letters of actors are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Radical actors run riot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' looks like an anagram signal for 'actors', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidel Castro led the Cuban revolution, the archetypal revolutionary.

clue.text: Appearing at end of street, a politician creates impression

indicators.note: says the following pieces come after the street abbreviation

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician turns up at the end of the road and makes a mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A stamp is a mark pressed into something, an impression or imprint.

clue.text: Where sad birds gathered to provide a sort of message

definitions.meaning: in the nursery rhyme Who Killed Cock Robin?, the grieving birds gather about the dead bird
a letter or petition signed by many, or a circular sent to a group

explanation.surface: Mourning birds assemble to deliver a communication.
explanation.walkthrough: In the rhyme all the birds of the air sigh and sob for poor Cock Robin.
explanation.definitionFit: A round robin is a petition with signatures in a circle, or a newsy letter sent to many.

clue.text: A bit of a character giving Jerry grief

parts.note: Tom is the cat forever chasing the mouse Jerry in the cartoons

explanation.surface: A cartoon persona harassing the mouse.
explanation.definitionFit: An atom is the smallest particle, used loosely for a tiny bit or iota.

clue.text: Kind to work as key operator

definitions.meaning: to use a keyboard, pressing keys to write

explanation.surface: Keyboard work suits a certain sort of person.
explanation.definitionFit: Type is both a category and the verb for keyboarding text.

clue.text: Jumpy little creature here looking silly in hat

indicators.note: in places the scrambled word inside the hat

parts.note: a topper is a top hat

indicators.note: looking silly means the letters of here are made to look odd by rearranging

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A nervous small animal looks ridiculous in a hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little creature' suggests something like a grasshopper; 'looking silly' makes REEH, which 'in' sets inside the top hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A treehopper is a small leaping insect, a sap-sucking bug that jumps.
